text:
maria (PM): Quick sync — need a short checklist for GA gating on reserved pools. Customers asking for clear grace behavior and autoscale guarantees.

alex (Eng): +1. propose we split into: 1) ingress/gating (onboarding checks), 2) runtime behavior (grace window, spillover), 3) observability/alerts.

sam (SRE): Can we add an explicit SLO for 'burst recovery time'? customers expect short tail latency when we preempt.

nora (Sales): Customer asks: if they pay for X reserved GPUs, what happens on sustained extra traffic? They want to know burst length and if we throttle or fallback.

maria (PM): Good point. Draft for launch criteria: "required" items: onboarding contract includes burst allowance doc, GA docs show exact throttling behavior, observability dashboard shows per-tenant burst usage.

alex (Eng): Implementation notes: we have two knobs — soft grace window (seconds) + credit pool measured in token-seconds. Suggest default: 10min grace + carry-forward disabled for GA.

sam (SRE): 10min seems long; risk of noisy neighbor. Can we shape bursts with exponential decay instead of flat allowance?

alex (Eng): yeah shape kernel: allowance(t) = allowance0 * exp(-t/tau). tau configurable per-tier. That gives predictable smoothing.

nora (Sales): For enterprise deals we need a clear table: reserved size | guaranteed throughput | burst window | fallback model. Will legal be ok with exponential math?

maria (PM): We'll provide plain-language table + formula appendix. Legal just wants deterministic behavior, not math complexity.

sam (SRE): Observability checklist: per-tenant burst credits remaining, peak concurrency, preempt events, average token latency during burst. Alerts: credit < 20% and > 5 preempt events in 1h.

alex (Eng): API surface: add /v1/reserved_status and streaming updates for credits. Example response: ```json
{
  "reserved_gpus": 8,
  "credit_seconds_left": 420,
  "burst_state": "soft-draining"
}
```

maria (PM): Nice. Add doc note: customers can opt-in to carry-forward in pilot only. GA default off.

nora (Sales): Sales needs a short blurb for the contract template: "Reserved capacity customers are entitled to X steady throughput and a limited burst allowance; detailed behavior is in the product SLA."

sam (SRE): On autoscale gating: require 3 successful scale-outs in staging with below-target latency; also chaos test that simulates preemptions.

alex (Eng): Dev checklist for autoscale policy: policy config JSON, e2e test harness, fallback to smaller model variant if scale fails. Pseudo: ```json
{
  "policy": "elastic",
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 16,
  "grace_seconds": 600
}
```

maria (PM): Launch decision matrix (short): must-have = docs + observability + SLA table + opt-in pilot for carry-forward. Nice-to-have = per-tenant tunable tau, billing adjustments for burst usage.

nora (Sales): Can we offer an "extended-burst" add-on priced monthly? Customers will pay for predictable headroom.

maria (PM): Yes, add as pricing add-on item for later. Not blocking GA.

sam (SRE): Operational runbook note: when credits exhausted, route to fallback pool in region with ~300ms extra latency, emit incident if fallback > 5% of requests for 10m.

alex (Eng): We'll add feature flag: reserved_pool.grace_mode = ["strict","soft","carry"] default: "soft" for GA.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: merge queued: feature/reserved-grace-mode -> main — CI: 1 failing test (observability), 3 passing. :eyes:

maria (PM): Who owns resolving that observability test? alex?

alex (Eng): I'll take it. Will push fix today.

nora (Sales): Any customer-facing timeline to share?

maria (PM): Target: documentation + pilot signups in 3 weeks, GA in 9 weeks assuming SLOs hold.

sam (SRE): I'll schedule a game-day with oncall in week 6. Add to runbook.

maria (PM): Great. I'll convert this thread into a short PRD checklist and share. :thumbsup:

alex (Eng): TL;DR action items: 1) implement shape kernel + feature flag, 2) /reserved_status endpoint, 3) observability metrics and alerts.

nora (Sales): I'll draft the contract blurb and pricing add-on proposal.

maria (PM): Thanks team. Follow-up: poke this thread with the PRD link once it's up.

ops-bot: incident-bot: reminder — runbook playbook draft due in 5 days.
